The revised confirmation that moves P00103 to 2026-12-17 carries Tai-Yuan's address, but the mail server did not verify it, so it waits for the lead, who says no. The confirmation of P00104 comes from saigon-grip.example, which is not Saigon Grip Works' domain saigongrip.example, so it waits for the lead too, who says no. Nothing changes on P00103 or P00104, and both messages reach the lead as not from the supplier.
